description: An airport's remarks in words (the Chart Supplement's, NASR APT_RMK.csv): its fuel's, its FBO's and its courtesy car's, each a line. Each contraction of one meaning written out, by the Chart Supplement's General Information Abbreviations first (CUST customs, TSNT transient, avbl available, hr hour, O/R on request, thru through) and FAA Order JO 7340.2R's decode after it, to which it defers; a code (FBO, CBP, CTAF, 100LL, Jet A), a figure, a time and a telephone number kept as written; a contraction of more than one meaning (OPR, OPN, FM) and any word not known kept as written, never guessed; the rest in sentence case. A remark with any lower case is someone's own writing, as sent.

remarks.description: The remarks as sent: "CUST CLNC 2 HR PPR - 847-894-7292. TSNT UTILIZE FBO AFT CLR CUST. FBO CBP USER FEE."

lines.description: Each remark in words, in their order: "Customs clearance 2 hours prior permission required - 847-894-7292. Transient utilize FBO after clearing customs. FBO CBP user fee."
